changelog: - **Connection kinds and Focus: keyboard focus visible when chosen.** In the tool row, when the chosen connection kind has keyboard focus, a dark ring is now drawn inside its pressed ring; in the status bar, Focus when on and keyboard-focused takes a dark dashed edge on its pressed ring. Before, the focus ring sat on the pressed ring in the same colour and could not be seen. High-contrast mode is unchanged; a control that is only chosen, or only focused, looks as before.
